region.ui:help: Select the Azure region to deploy your VM. Instance sizes shown below are filtered to only those available in this region.

operatingSystem.ui:help: Select your preferred operating system for the VM.

linuxType.ui:help: Choose your Linux distribution. Only applies when OS is Linux.

addHybridBenefit.ui:help: Apply existing Windows Server licenses to reduce costs. Windows OS only.

count.ui:help: Total number of VM instances to deploy.

hours.ui:help: Average hours per month the VM will be running.

tier.ui:help: Disk performance tier: standardhdd (cheapest), standardssd (balanced), premiumssd (high-performance)

redundancy.ui:help: LRS: locally redundant, ZRS: zone-redundant (higher cost)

type.ui:help: internet-egress for outbound public internet, inter-region for cross-region traffic

routedVia.ui:help: premium: Microsoft backbone network, isp: public internet (cheaper but slower)
